items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: I don't know no McNicious place

ctx.x: Well, uh, I think I was around, must have been around about 22, 23 years old. Oh yeah, he was old.

Oh, I see, Fess was talking about someplace, McNicious place. What was that, the fellow ran and had a bar, was that at that corner too? Hmm. Remember the name right now? Yeah. McNicious or something like that. Hmm. McNicious, yeah, I remember McNicious. There was a place there, but I don't remember how hard it was.

The only ones I know, and I practically know that place, from around there, from Iverville, the Rays all the way up to Ramport Street. Iverville, Bienville, I don't know no McNicious place, the only thing. Lala, I know Pete Lala, there was, like I told you, Lala was on the Rays in Iverville.
